name: React Icons
summary: React SVG icon components for 30+ popular icon packs, imported per icon so only the icons used are bundled.
description: react-icons packages the icons of more than 30 icon sets as React SVG components, each pack under its own import path (react-icons/md, react-icons/fa6, react-icons/tb …). Install from npm; TypeScript support is native and ES6 imports keep the bundle small. Icons can be configured through props and the React Context API.
contains: icons from 30+ icon packs, each with its own import path, e.g. import { ICONNAME } from 'react-icons/md'
per-pack counts in the README, e.g. Phosphor 9,072, Tabler 5,237, Material Design 4,341, Bootstrap 2,716
TypeScript native support; ES6 imports include only the icons a project uses
configuration via props or the React Context API; migration guide from v2 to v3
preview site built with Astro + React
